payload.authorizing_milestone: AGENTS.md T4 autonomous-search strategy reset, 2026-09-16: keep learned proposal-prior training explicitly separate until its split-clean data and actual-sampler support are verified. Strategy report section 10 declares this as the first zero-oracle experiment of the revision.
payload.budget_semantics: the wall-clock stopping budget is lifted for this probe so the attempt count is the binding budget; a wall cap is an operational stopping rule, not a support property. Realized attempts and elapsed seconds are recorded either way.
claim_boundaries: the archive lane supplies a known answer and measures conditional support only
only the bootstrap lane is a teacher-free autonomous measurement
proximity to historically scored endpoints is reported with the historical score attached to the historical molecule, never assigned to a generated one
local RDKit is newer than the pinned benchmark image; this is a support probe, not a replacement for a pinned-image result

family_registry.note: read at runtime and recorded in the artifact; never retyped in this contract

gate.decision_rule: PASS only if all three hold. A failure names the family or context and is preserved; failing to sample an exact historical endpoint in this budget is not itself a failure and never a zero-support proof.
gate.exact_realization_of_supplied_program: every probe context's historical champion must pass unchanged archive admission, which replays the program and asserts endpoint identity
gate.no_deterministic_support_exclusion: pooled across the five contexts, a declared family attempted at least 8 times must be realized at least once; per-context zeros are reported as context facts, because a family can be legitimately inapplicable to one molecule
gate.repeated_proposal_keeps_exploring: in every context, every bootstrap round after the first must draw at least one proposal signature (lane, chosen module families and parameters, endpoint, status) not drawn in an earlier round. Distinct endpoints are reported alongside but do not gate: two different proposals can legitimately reach the same molecule when the legal space is small, which would conflate chemistry with the repetition defect.

archive.description: answer-known conditional support: the historical champion is injected into the archive for diagnostics only, then one ObjectiveProgramSearch batch is proposed; nothing here is a runtime controller input

bootstrap.description: teacher-free cold start from the cell's own original benchmark root, through the unchanged ProgressiveBootstrap; this is the autonomous measurement

prohibitions: no Modal launch and no live-run access
no model fit and no learned prior
no change to the sampler, compiler, executor or eligibility
no candidate lock and no scored launch authority
payload.question: Through the reset revision's actual production proposal path, and not an alternate teacher-only compiler path, does every declared generic construction family have runtime support, does repeated proposal keep exploring, and does a supplied known-good program still realize exactly?

source_registry.consistency_assertion: for each context the runtime unit's original_seed and oracle_protocol must equal the historical result unit's; a mismatch aborts the probe
source_registry.role: the frozen benchmark start graph, source group and original seed for every probe cell; the historical result files carry a champion and a protocol but no root state, so the root must come from the revision's own runtime contract

supersedes.reason: the first seal bound the historical result files but no benchmark root state, so the bootstrap lane could not be constructed; re-sealed before any probe attempt was sampled, with no change to lanes, budgets, seeds, gate or prohibitions; then the exploration criterion was restated from endpoint identity to proposal identity, again before any contract-budget probe attempt was sampled, because the defect under test is a repeated proposal and a small legal endpoint space would otherwise read as that defect. Lanes, budgets, seeds, the other two gate criteria and the prohibitions are unchanged.
